questions.q: 6. In a certain code language, "DRAMA" is written as ‘32"and "PLAY" is written as "50". How will "THEATRE" be written in that language?
questions.s:
6.(c)

Logic : - (Sum of the place value of the letters) - (Number of letters)

DRAMA → 32

⇒ D(4) + R(18) + A(1) + M(13) + A(1) = 37

⇒ 37 - (Number of letters in DRAMA)

⇒ 37 - 5

⇒ 32

PLAY → 50

⇒ P(16) + L(12) + A(1) + Y(25) = 54

⇒ 54 - (Number of letters in PLAY)

⇒ 54 - 4

⇒ 50

Similarly,

THEATRE → 70

⇒ T(20) + H(8) + E(5) + A(1) + T(20) + R(18) + E(5) = 77

⇒ 77 - (Number of letters in THEATRE)

⇒ 77- 7

So, soft is written as B4.

And 'communicate conquer' is written as 'D2 G7' (in any order).

So, the code for 'soft conquer' is 'B4 D2' or 'B4 G7'.
